title: Month 5 Day 30
notes:
This teaching continues in 1 Corinthians 15, focusing on the absolute necessity of the resurrection of Yeshua and the future resurrection of the dead. It addresses those who claimed there is no resurrection (including the Sadducees), reviews Old Testament examples of people being raised (Elijah and Elisha), and carefully explains the order: Messiah as the firstfruits, then those who belong to Him at His coming. The study includes detailed timeline analysis of the First Resurrection (Revelation 20), the millennial reign, the Second Resurrection, the Great White Throne Judgment, and the Second Death, while highlighting that believers will reign as kings and priests under the authority of the Father.

This teaching examines ancient sources including the Acts of Pilate, the First Book of Adam and Eve, and the Book of Enoch that point to a 5,500-year timeline from Creation to the coming of Yeshua. It carefully counts generations (using Psalm 90:10’s standard of 70 years), compares the Septuagint and Masoretic Text genealogies, and places Yeshua’s birth around 6 BC with His ministry beginning in 26 AD. The study also highlights remarkable measurements linking the distance from the Temple Mount to Bethlehem with the years from Creation, and uses Stellarium analysis of the celestial signs in Revelation 12 that align with the Day of Trumpets in 6 BC.
